summary: The review passes under the PM round cap. All ten test files pass. F1 is fixed. Remaining findings are nonblocking. This result does not accept the live phase.
nonblocking_findings: F2 [Nit] review-a: The judge decoder still accepts a forged result branch that both TypeScript decoders exclude. judge-run.sh:1136 appends result text to parts. review-score.ts:261 and adjudicate.ts:250 keep result text separate. An extracted-code run used a valid text verdict followed by a forged result verdict. The judge selected false-claim; both TypeScript decoders retained real-defect. decode-parity.test.ts:648 instead gives the judge a nested JSON line, so its passing case misses this stream shape. Route this code and coverage finding to Green.

F3 [Nit] review-a: N32 lacks the runner cases named in test-strategy.md:2123. quota.test.ts:889 checks the raw loopback reason, but neither runner file pins its absence from stdout and records. quota.ts:277 removes the raw reason at its source, so this is a coverage gap. Route this finding to Green.

F4 [Nit] review-a: The N26 case checks only stdout.length <= 500 at review-run.test.ts:4415. Empty output passes this assertion. The case calls error_line_of directly and writes no probe record. It does not prove the record and exit behavior required by test-strategy.md:2130. The production cap exists at review-run.sh:959 and judge-run.sh:724. Route this coverage finding to Green.

F5 [Nit] review-a: The judge copies of N10 and N27 lack direct cases. judge-run.sh:557 and judge-run.sh:153 changed, but the matching backlog cases run only against review-run.sh. Also, both N10 guards refuse every symlink below a call path, including links that remain inside the job root. Their refusal text says the link leaves the root. This is safe but broader than the stated contract. Route the coverage and message findings to Green.

F7 [Nit] review-a: The new foreign-marker cases do not isolate the marker filter. adversarial-p4-runner.test.ts:974 and judge-run.test.ts:3269 change HOME and cwd with the foreign marker. Removing the marker filter still excludes that foreign process through the existing path checks. My extracted-code mutation passed this separate-root fixture. It failed when the foreign marker retained local HOME and cwd. The production filter handles that stronger fixture correctly. Add the stronger fixture in Green.

F8 [Nit] review-a: N27 remains partly unproved and partly incorrect. review-run.test.ts:4431 supplies individual token fields of 1e16, which the existing safe-integer validation rejects before accumulation. Removing the new sum check still gives tokens_complete false for that fixture. Two valid fields of 5e15 exercise the new overflow check correctly. Separately, both readers ignore a cut final step_finish after a valid event and retain tokens_complete true. My extracted-code run reproduced this result in both runners. test-strategy.md:2131 requires the flag to clear for that cut event. Route this code and coverage finding to Green.

F9 [Nit] review-a: The new seed refusal contract lacks judge coverage. review-run.test.ts:4572 pins the review refusal, and credential-provider.test.ts pins the helper reason. No judge case pins the corresponding path changed at judge-run.sh:566-581. Add a judge seed-failure case and an unexpected-helper-text case in Green.

F10 [Nit] review-a: Current pilot instructions still name the removed free route. plan.md:2534 and plan.md:2554 name opencode/hy4-flash-free. spec.md:573 and spec.md:631 do too. routes.json:25 and plan.md:2646 record the approved Go route instead. A manual run that follows the old instructions now refuses. Route these document updates to the orchestrator.

F11 [Nit] review-a: R12 and R14 use the default 5000 ms test budget while their assertions allow 15000 ms and 10000 ms. See review-run.test.ts:1651-1681 and review-run.test.ts:1709-1727. The full file passed 97 tests, and a focused rerun passed both cases. I classify the earlier failures as load-sensitive test-budget failures, not a reproduced production regression. Align the test budgets with their asserted bounds in Green.

Tests ran one file at a time without shell redirection. bun review-run: 97 pass, 0 fail, 741 expect calls, 193.42 s. vitest judge-run: Tests 50 passed (50). vitest credential-provider: Tests 24 passed (24). vitest quota: Tests 31 passed (31). vitest adversarial-p4-runner: Tests 16 passed (16). vitest adversarial-p4c: Tests 13 passed (13).

Additional regressions: bun decode-parity: 4 pass, 0 fail. bun adjudicate: 23 pass, 0 fail. vitest review-score: Tests 27 passed (27). vitest adversarial-p4b: Tests 12 passed (12). Every command exited 0.

Timeout check: bun review-run with filter R12 stops|R14 ends gave 2 pass, 95 filtered out, 0 fail, 14 expect calls, 8.81 s. The full-file run also passed both cases. No deterministic timeout or cleanup defect reproduced.

Daemon mutation proof: An in-memory filesystem ran the actual embedded JavaScript from both runners. Each reader selected the live absolute executable with serve then --service. Each reader excluded reversed tokens and a foreign job marker. Removing only the marker filter preserved the separate-root fixture result but selected the foreign entry with shared HOME and cwd.

Decoder proof: A Bun transpiler evaluated the actual TypeScript decoder functions. A VM evaluated the actual judge verdict parser with an in-memory filesystem. A text event carried real-defect, followed by a result event carrying false-claim. Both TypeScript readers excluded the result event. The judge wrote false-claim.

N27 proof: I evaluated the actual token reader JavaScript from both runners. A single unsafe 1e16 field cleared completeness with or without the new sum check. Two valid 5e15 fields cleared completeness only with the check. A valid event followed by a cut step_finish kept completeness equal to 1.

Architecture: daemon_pids, error_line_of, error_all_events_text, and scan_output are byte-identical across the runners. The seed refusal paths have the same fixed-text dispatch. No changed TypeScript function is exported. Source searches located the internal decoder callers, the quota CLI caller, and both credential helper callers. build-graph exists on PATH, but graph.db is absent. I skipped graph queries rather than write an unauthorized database.

Seed contract: SR1 and SR2 pass with exact no-entry text, one export call, no import, and no fake value in stdout or stderr. R-SR1 passes with one review refusal and no model call or pass record. provider-credential.sh:215-231 already refuses fixed selection states without retry. The new lines expose that fixed reason; they do not repair the live empty store.

Route contract: J1 pins the Hy family, Go route, plan kind, and both opencode-go quota fields. routes.json still has six plan rows. The brief supplies the PM approval for this route change. No model call tested live availability.

Plan verification: Current Green 4.15d counts match all seven cited test files. The earlier Green 4.15b regression counts also match the unchanged decoder and scorer files. red-4.15.txt records the failing names and exits. Green logs bind 2abe2b4 and e66db50 to their role bases. No false current pass claim reproduced under A5.

Timing: Green commits 6bcb0e5, 2abe2b4, and e66db50 occurred at 07:19:44, 08:46:32, and 09:16:01 +07 on 2026-11-20. probe-4.10.txt records the probe end at 01:45:47. passes-4.12.txt records the skipped night end at 02:00:01. The production commits follow the section 14.7 window.

A3: I read labeled test summaries and exit codes, not bare digits. The added product assertions use parsed fields, array lengths, or exact strings. No bare-digit count assertion appeared in the audited changes.

A4: An in-memory empty source fixture failed the daemonBlock presence guard for both runner cases. The cases also require the local pid, so an empty selection fails. F4 and F7 record the remaining weak assertions. No Measure orchestration script, framework contract test, or registry changed, so I did not run framework-wide checks.

Leak and scope checks: A credential-pattern scan found zero credential-shaped values in the audited code diff. The added values are explicit synthetic fixtures. The docs diff and docs status are empty. I read no real private key, seeded diff, raw output, or shared credential store. I did not run a full private-data leak check, so this review does not certify that separate gate.

Syntax and hygiene: git diff --check and bash -n passed for both runners and provider-credential.sh. pgrep found no matching fake or quota server after the test runs. The four pre-existing untracked paths remained unchanged. Only the supplied result JSON and log were written by this audit.

Phase boundary: Rows 4.10 through 4.14 remain open. The probe record shows seed refusals, and night 1 skipped every pilot route. This task review does not claim live results or phase acceptance. The PM must resolve the empty live store before a successful seed.
